newsitem.title: USA: Lexington County, S.C., approves sewer initiative.
newsitem.headline: Lexington County, S.C., approves sewer initiative.

text.p: Lexington County residents approved an initiative that would allow the county to use general fund revenues and property taxes to operate the water and sewer systems, an official in the county voter registration office said Wednesday.

Lexington County voters approved the measure by voting 37,780 yes and 19,432 no, the official said. The county, located in the central part of South Carolina, had prohibited such use of funds in a 1970 referendum.

The new proposal would restrict such expenditures to certain circumstances -- at the request of residents willing to form a special tax district to pay their own costs, to provide for economic development, to address health or environmental problems or if there is funding through grants or from revenues from operating water and sewer system.
